loadErrorText: Reload the page in a little while. The meetings and documents aren't affected.
basisNone: Goals can be proposed once the association has had its first meetings with Simon Says.
basisOwn: The goals rest on {own, plural, one {# finished meeting} other {# finished meetings}}{since}. Test meetings don't count.
basisImported: The goals rest on {imported, plural, one {# imported set of minutes} other {# imported sets of minutes}}{since}. Meetings with Simon Says count from the first meeting on.
basisBoth: The goals rest on {imported, plural, one {# imported set of minutes} other {# imported sets of minutes}} and {own, plural, one {# meeting with Simon Says} other {# meetings with Simon Says}}{since}. Test meetings don't count.
proposeFailed: Simon Says couldn't propose goals. Try again.
offline: We couldn't reach the server. Check the network and try again.
importedCount: {count, plural, one {# set of minutes imported} other {# sets of minutes imported}}.
failedCount: {count, plural, one {# set of minutes couldn't be read} other {# sets of minutes couldn't be read}}.
clearFailed: The imported minutes couldn't be removed. Try again.
readingHistory: Simon Says is reading the whole history, old minutes and your meetings, in order … It may take a minute or so.
readingMeetings: Simon Says is reading the decisions and items from your meetings …
noGoalsPropose: Let Simon Says propose 3–5 goals based on what keeps coming up at your meetings. You change and approve them before anyone else sees them.
noGoalsTooFew: Simon Says can propose goals once the association has had at least 3 meetings. You can write your own goals right now.
noGoalsMember: When an admin has approved the association's goals, they show up here.
historyBasis: The proposals also rest on {count, plural, one {# imported old set of minutes} other {# imported old sets of minutes}}.
removeAllConfirm: Remove all imported minutes? Approved goals stay.
goalNeedsTitle: Each goal needs a title. Remove the goals you don't want.
saveFailed: The goals couldn't be saved. Try again.
editorIntro: Change, remove or add. Everyone in the association sees the goals once you've approved them. At most {max} goals.
goalPlaceholder: The goal, e.g. More members by spring
othersText: Achieved, dropped and ones not mentioned for a long time. Others don't see them unless you add them.
